notes.title: Toing's Pops 2 Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update includes balancing, bug fixes, and performance increases.

Balancing:
[list]
[*][b]Kerberos[/b]
- If killed in phase one or two, you will get teleported to the portal.

[b]Projection of Chardonnay[/b]
- Increased damage dealt without supercharged (previously 3, now 4.5)
   I might increase this even more in the future, but I felt like the difference between non supercharged 
   and supercharged was way too much.
- Reduced damage taken by Chardonnay's tracking rounds (previously dealt 10 damage per hit, now 
   does 7)
     I changed this because having to sit around getting your health back for a long time doesn't seem 
     too fun.

[b]Performance:[/b]
- Enceladus performed seriously badly, and performed especially badly on hardware without hardware ray tracing. 
    I feel super dumb having left on hardware ray tracing, and ray tracing in general. I turned it on and 
    never noticed because I have a higher end card with hardware ray tracing, so I was never able to 
    notice this.
    The lighting as a whole in Toing's Pops 2 has been slightly tweaked, but shouldn't look super 
    different. Performance as a whole however should be significantly better. If it isn't please let me 
    know, and also what specs your PC has.
[/list]

- Reduced damage taken by Chardonnay's tracking rounds (previously dealt 10 damage per hit, now
